description:
For nurseries that need maximum storage without sacrificing style, the Addison 7 Drawer Dresser delivers. Seven dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides offer generous space for clothing, bedding, and nursery essentials, all within a solid hardwood frame finished in warm Brown Maple.

The spacious top accommodates a changing pad, creating a dedicated diaper-changing station. Every finish is non-toxic and baby-safe, meeting the highest safety standards. Designed to coordinate with the complete Addison collection, this dresser transitions beautifully from nursery to tween bedroom.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
